Marcus, I replied in the #north-team thread that Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations, is the main contact at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

My first reply overstated the source. The North cheat sheet names Thea as the main contact, but it doesn't mention door 6. The only link between Thea and the door 6 duplicates is the August thread in #north-team, where Dana says Thea flagged them. I posted a correction in the same thread.
